SELECT tm.*, gt.name AS transfer_name, se.name AS equipment_name, su.user_name AS handle_name FROM garbage_transfer_maintenance tm LEFT JOIN garbage_transfer gt ON tm.transfer_id = gt.transfer_id AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_equipment se ON tm.equipment_id = se.sys_equipment_id AND se.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON tm.handle_by = su.user_id AND su.deleted = 0
ORDER BY tm.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
